------Applicant  VERSUS   State Of Chhattisgarh through - The Station House Oicer,
 Police Station - Kotwali, District - Rajnandgaon, (C.G.)
 -------Non-applicant  For applicants : Mr. Parag Kotecha, Advocate
For Non-applicants-State : Mr. Shreyansh Mehta, Panel Lawyer
For Objector : Ms. Kavita Bansal, Advocate
SB: Hon'ble Shri Parth Prateem Sahu, Judge
ORDER ON BOARD  15/07/2024 1.

This is the irst bail application iled by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail, as he has been arrested in connection with Crime No. 53/2024 registered at Police Station - Kotwali, District - Rajnandgaon, Chhattisgarh for the ofences punishable under Sections 420, 467,
468, 471, 120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.

Case of the prosecution is that, report was lodged by one Santosh Kumar alleging that the applicant on the false pretext of providing Government Job in the Police Department on the post of Constable has procured Rs. 03,25,000/- in the year 2018 and thereafter, he has not provided the job nor returned the money.

During the course of investigation, the statement of the other persons were also recorded including Vinay Kumar and Bhola Ram Patel in which, they have also stated that the applicant has fradulently procured the amount on the pretext of providing government job and issued forged appointment letters to them also.
The applicant was Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:25618 arrested on 26.01.2024.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the instant crime, he has not committed any ofence as alleged.

He submits that the Piyush Wadhera vs The State Of Chhattisgarh on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32032847/
1 alleged incident if any, was of the year 2018.

sentences.text:
The report is lodged after a long delay, only on January,
2024.

There is no witness to support the allegation of Santosh Kumar (complainant) that he has handed over the money to the applicant in front of them and the objector before this Court has not lodged separate report in the concerned police station, therefore, the objection raised by Vinay Kumar may not considered.

4. On the other hand, learned State counsel opposes the submission made by learned counsel for the applicant and would submit that based on the report of Santosh Kumar, the crime was registered and during investigation, the statement of Vinay Kumar and Bhola Ram Patel was also recorded under Section 161 of Cr.P.C.
The appointment order stated to be forged is also part of the case-diary which was produced by Vinay Kumar and Bhola Ram Patel.

5. Learned counsel for the objector submits that the applicant by his fraudulent act has procured about Rs. 38 Lakhs all from the residents of Rajnandgaon district on the false assurance that he will get them government job.
Forged appointment order was also handed over.
Applicant also issued cheque of the same amount which he accepted to gain conidence of the victim.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the respective parties.

7. Taking into consideration, facts and circumstances of the case, nature of allegations, submission of learned counsel for the respective parties as also, nature of ofence committed by the applicant, I do not ind present to be a it case to allow the Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:25618 application for grant of bail.
8. Accordingly, the bail application for grant of bail is dismissed.
Certiied copy as per rules.
